e2-agents: Calls reaching the producer, relative to direct MCP, as the swarm grows (W-syn, overlap 0.5). Mean over 30 seeds; bars are 95% confidence intervals. (Simulation. Script: experiments/plots/make_figures.py; runs: e2-agents/20261127T102434Z-4e27e60b.)
e2-overlap: Calls reaching the producer, relative to direct MCP, as more of each agent's calls come from the shared catalog (W-syn, 8 agents). Mean over 30 seeds; bars are 95% confidence intervals. (Simulation. Script: experiments/plots/make_figures.py; runs: e2-overlap/20261127T102522Z-4e27e60b.)
e2-latency: Left: distribution of the consumer-observed latency of every call. Right: change of the per-run p50 and p95 against B0, paired by seed (mean over 30 seeds, 95% CI). (Simulation. Script: experiments/plots/make_figures.py; runs: e2-agents/20261127T102434Z-4e27e60b.)
e2-sensitivity: Upstream reduction at the base workload when one parameter changes: the manifest TTL, the byte budget of each Content Store, and the agents' mean think time (mean over seeds, 95% CI). (Simulation. Script: experiments/plots/make_figures.py; runs: e2-ttl/20261127T102600Z-4e27e60b, e2-cs-size/20261127T102640Z-4e27e60b, e2-think-time/20261127T102713Z-4e27e60b.)

e2-surface: Calls reaching the producer, relative to direct MCP, as more of the URLs are written in an equivalent form (W-syn, 8 agents, overlap 0.5). B5 keys on the arguments as sent; IDEM on the producer-declared canonical arguments. Mean over 30 seeds; bars are 95% confidence intervals. (Simulation. Script: experiments/plots/make_figures.py; runs: e2-surface/20261127T102802Z-4e27e60b.)
e2-code-burst: W-code: 8 agents x 16 calls, no surface variation, agents start within 1 s, as the burst grows. Left: upstream reduction against direct MCP; middle: share of cacheable requests B2's PIT aggregated; right: calls per run B5 sent upstream while an identical call was in flight. e2-code-sync: W-code: 8 agents x 16 calls in bursts of 4, no surface variation, as the agents' start window shrinks. Panels as in e2-code-burst. Mean over 30 seeds; bars are 95% confidence intervals. e5-safety: Outcome of every attack variant over 250 trials each, against the core engine on a virtual clock. A variant counts as rejected only if no victim accepted forged, foreign or out-of-lifetime content and no cache kept any. The 3 baseline/ rows run the attack of the IDEM variant they mirror against B5, the unsigned shared gateway cache: acceptance is their expected outcome, and they are not IDEM claims. (Simulation. Script: experiments/plots/make_figures.py; runs: e5-safety/20261127T102848Z-4e27e60b.)
e4-producer-link: Calls that reached the producer and frames received over the producer link (both directions, Ethernet frames) against link loss, HTTP overlay vs native NDN on the same Docker links. Mean over 3 seeds; bars are 95% confidence intervals. (Emulation. Script: experiments/plots/make_figures.py; runs: e4/20261118T141957Z-de2bcf73.)
e4-latency: Consumer-observed latency of answered calls and the fraction of calls answered, against link loss. The overlay recovers loss in TCP; the native consumer re-expresses an Interest with a fresh Nonce after its lifetime. Mean over 3 seeds; bars are 95% confidence intervals. (Emulation. Script: experiments/plots/make_figures.py; runs: e4/20261118T141957Z-de2bcf73.)
e4-hops: Content Store hits per forwarder at 0% loss, mean over 3 seeds (hops.csv). (Emulation. Script: experiments/plots/make_figures.py; runs: e4/20261118T141957Z-de2bcf73.)
